what: GREENWATER-STORY-001: which field of the accepted writing each native record of the Greenwater road takes its text from, when each is shown, what each button then does, and what of the writing is deliberately not imported. Checked by tools/papyrus_sim/test_greenwater_projection.py against the plugin as built and the story JSON. Not a compile and not a game test.

limit.why: As docs/design/ACT1_RUNTIME_001_MAPPING.json: this project's margin under the 255 at which the game was seen to cut a box short.

who_can_speak: Everywhere below, 'alive, present and in no fight' is TLM:MQ02BQuest.CanSpeak on the person's alias: not dead, not disabled, not in combat. Nobody who fails it says a line, is handed a prisoner or hands anything over. No rule asks for more people than the action needs.

not_imported: The effect 'mq02b set 20' on its first button: stage 20 is set when her account (starnes_wants) has been shown and answered, not when it is asked for.

speech.then: Only if, after the box, the player is alive on the road and Opal is still alive, present and in no fight (her question is answered to her; otherwise nothing is carried out and nothing more is said): 0 -> Hang; 1 -> Custody, then her starnes_denied; 2 -> Release, then her starnes_denied. Each asks again for the people it needs (read again after the box closes, before anything is written), Hatcher in no fight among them.
not_imported: The effects 'mq02b set 60' and 'mq02b set 61' as button effects: 60 and 61 are set only by Hang and Custody once the hanging or the hand-over is seen to have happened.
Its condition as written (41 done, 60 and 61 not, Hatcher alive) alone: the order adds actual whole delivery.

ui.what: This build speaking: product availability, what is representation, what a test should write down. In square brackets on the screen and never attributed to a character. Each text below is the built record's.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

Only the Greenwater road is playable in this candidate. It is a greybox: flat ground and labelled stand-ins. Travel there now?
boxes.shown_when: The Mercy travel point, with TLM_MQ01's stages 50, 60 and 100 set, its Done global 1 and its delivery acknowledged. 0 travels (the same asked again after the box); 1 nothing.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

The Greenwater road is complete. You can go back: what was settled stays settled.
boxes.shown_when: As AskTravel once the road is complete.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

Not yet. Deliver the marshal's dispatch to Sheriff Pritchard and hear him out first.
boxes.shown_when: The travel point before the chapter is over.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

Greenwater could not be set up. Nothing was changed. See the script log.
boxes.shown_when: The road's quest could not be started or the arrival marker is not placed: nobody is moved.

boxes.text:
[Anchor chain]

One cut frees the barge for the Chute. Or burn the Queen. Thirty people are aboard - crew, cooks, the fiddler - and the winter grain is still lashed alongside. Fire can take them and the cargo. Say what you're ordering.
boxes.shown_when: The anchor chain when Rafferty is dead, absent or in a fight: the occupancy warning as this build's own text. The words under the heading are pruitt_chain's, and its three buttons; nobody is given as saying them (order, item 10; contract, 'Rafferty dead').

boxes.text:
[Anchor chain]

The chain is cut. From here there are no cards, no share and no fire: use the barge's pilot lever to run the Chute.
boxes.shown_when: The chain was just cut, or is used again with an escape pending.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

There is nothing more to do here.
boxes.shown_when: The chain or the firebox with a course already taken.

boxes.text:
[Boiler firebox]

Not yet. Find out who and what is aboard first: the anchor chain, where the barge is lashed.
boxes.shown_when: The firebox before the warning was delivered.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

Nothing is burning. The order is given at the boiler firebox on the Queen's deck, and cannot be taken back.
boxes.shown_when: 'Burn the occupied Queen.' on the chain's box: the warning is recorded; nothing burns.

boxes.text:
[Boiler firebox]

Thirty people are aboard and the winter grain is lashed alongside. This cannot be undone.
boxes.shown_when: The firebox, warned, no course taken, no escape pending, and the burned Queen's marker placed. Its two buttons are pruitt_chain's second and third. 0, with the player alive on a road that stands as it stood before the box -> OrderFire, then the fire staged, then stage 43 only if the road itself sees the burned marker on and the lashed cargo off (FireDone is handed both).

boxes.text:
[Greybox]

The occupied Queen burns with the grain lashed alongside. The fire is shown by the marker on her deck. Nobody's death is counted here.
boxes.shown_when: Stage 43 just recorded. On its one button, with the player alive on the road, the player (and Rafferty) are set down at the landing; otherwise nobody is moved and the record stands.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

The fire could not be shown, so nothing is recorded. Use the firebox again.
boxes.shown_when: The fire was ordered and was not seen staged: nothing is recorded, the marker is switched off again and the cargo is as the facts have it; the firebox, seen to be switched on, stages it again. The fire stays ordered and exclusive.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

The fire cannot be shown in this build: its marker is missing. No order was given and nothing is changed. Report this to the tester.
boxes.shown_when: The firebox, warned, with the burned Queen's marker not placed: no order is taken and nothing is changed.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

The fire was ordered and cannot be shown: a piece of this build is missing or cannot be switched on. Nothing is recorded and no other course is open. Report this to the tester.
boxes.shown_when: The fire was ordered and cannot be shown: its marker is not placed, or it was not seen and the firebox is missing or cannot be switched on. Nothing is recorded; no instruction to use the firebox is given.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

The cargo could not be shown at the landing, so nothing is recorded. Use the barge's pilot lever again, then walk to the return dock.
boxes.shown_when: The return dock reached with a return pending, and the cargo was not seen at the landing (its piece not on, or the lashed one not off): nothing is recorded, the pieces are put back as the facts stand, the return and the chain lock stay pending.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

The cargo cannot be shown at the landing: a piece of this build is missing. Nothing is recorded. Report this to the tester.
boxes.shown_when: The return dock reached with a return pending, and the cargo's piece at the landing is not placed: nothing is recorded; the return stays pending.

boxes.text:
[Barge pilot lever]

The barge is still lashed to the Queen.
boxes.shown_when: The pilot lever with nothing to bring home.

boxes.text:
[Greybox]

Hangman's Chute is a short walk in this build. Walk to the return dock: the run counts when you reach it.
boxes.shown_when: The pilot lever with an escape pending. Only on its one button, and with the player alive on a road that stands as it stood before the box and the head of the Chute placed: the return is begun (BeginReturn) and the player is set down at the head of the strip. Otherwise nobody is moved and nothing is begun; a return begun before stays begun. Stage 42 is not set here.

boxes.text:
[Greybox]

The barge you won is brought round to the landing. Walk to the return dock: the grain is home when you reach it.
boxes.shown_when: The pilot lever with the barge won at cards and not yet home. As NoteChuteScene.

boxes.text:
[Greybox]

Rafferty's skiff sets you down at the Queen's off side, by the barge. Walk aboard from there.
boxes.shown_when: The skiff to the Queen's off side. Only on its one button, and with the player alive on a road that stands as it stood before the box: the player, and Rafferty if he is alive and present, are set down there. Otherwise nobody is moved.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

The whole barge is at the landing: 12 of 12 measures. The count is this build's bookkeeping.
boxes.shown_when: The return dock reached with the won barge, and the whole cargo's piece seen on at the landing and the lashed one off: cargo home whole.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

Part of the cargo came through the Chute: 8 of 12 measures. The count is this build's bookkeeping.

boxes.text:

Opal Starnes has not heard what became of the barge.
buttons: Tell her the Chute took it

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

No share was paid and no deal was made. See the script log.

boxes.text:
[Faro table]

Nobody is dealing here.

boxes.text:
[Greenwater story test]

Lyle Hatcher is in Sheriff Pritchard's custody.

boxes.text:

No food item is built into this candidate. Nothing was given.

That could not be carried out. Nothing is recorded.

[Skiff to Mercy]

Leave Greenwater? The road is complete once you are back at Mercy Crossing.

boxes.text:
[Skiff to Mercy]

Nothing is settled at Greenwater. Leaving settles nothing; you can come back.

Leave Greenwater?

The Greenwater road is complete. Sheriff Pritchard will hear what became of the grain.

documents.shown_when: The ration board is used. Sets nothing.
documents.cut: Only at the document's own line breaks, a blank line for preference; the pages, put together with the line breaks they were cut at, are the document.

documents.shown_when: The strongbox is used, by anybody aboard, whoever lives.
documents.then: Every page answered: LearnHire (letter) -> stage 50, silver_river; and the book TLM_BOOK_LetterOfHire, once. A page left unanswered: nothing is learned.

book.title: title
book.why: The letter itself, to carry and read again. Knowing the hire does not depend on carrying it.

not_imported: The evidence entry's 'sets 50' on opening the strongbox: opening it is not reading it.
The roll of silver the letter is wrapped round: no item is given for it.

stages.set_when: The player is inside the landing's box, with the road's quest running (Arrive). Not at the travel point.
Opal's starnes_wants shown and answered, Opal alive, present and in no fight (HearOpal). Never forced; never needed for boarding.
The player is inside the gangway's or the off side's box, or first uses a piece of the deck (Board). Not locked by stage 20 or by anybody living.
The table or Hatcher is used with Hatcher alive, present, in no fight and free, and no course taken (SitDown).
PlayCards: the player's current Charisma, read from the game, is 5 or more. The cargo becomes YIELDED, not delivered.
stages.not: Does not deliver the grain, set grain_home or earn any of Opal's lines.

stages.set_when: CompleteReturn: the player is inside the return dock's box with an escape pending and the pilot lever's notice confirmed, AND the road itself sees the reduced cargo's piece on at the landing and the lashed one off. Cargo home reduced: 8 of 12 with Rafferty alive and present, 6 without.
FireDone: the warning delivered, the order confirmed at the firebox with no course taken and no escape pending, AND the road itself sees the burned marker on and the lashed cargo off.

stages.log_ui: You accepted Hatcher's share. The grain remains aboard the Queen.
stages.set_when: TakeShare: 200 caps seen to have arrived, once.
stages.not: The accepted text of 44 speaks of the lie and of Opal's thanks, which payment does not earn; it is on 46.

stages.set_when: PlayCards with current Charisma under 5. Not a course; nothing is taken; set once however often the hand is lost.
LieWasHeard: 44, paid, the lie explicitly told, and Opal's starnes_after_share shown and answered with Opal alive, present and in no fight after it.
stages.why: Carries the accepted journal text of 44 at the moment it becomes true.

stages.set_when: LearnHire: the letter read through to its last page, or Hatcher's admission heard to its end from Hatcher at his table, alive, present and in no fight between its halves and after its last.

RecordHanging, reached only from Hang or from Hatcher's death event while an execution is under way. Hang: 41; Hatcher alive, present, in no fight and free; Opal alive, present and in no fight; the steeple's ring placed and switched on; the explicit button. He is moved, SEEN at the ring (same cell, within 256 units) and everybody asked for again BEFORE one Kill; then seen dead within the wait (30 looks a tenth of a second apart). A death with no execution under way, or after the wait gave up, is a death otherwise (4).

Custody: 41; Hatcher alive, present, in no fight and free; Pritchard alive, present and in no fight; the explicit button; Hatcher seen alive in Pritchard's cell, within reach of him, and everybody asked for again after the move; then restrained.
Complete: one of 42, 43, 44 with the share paid, or 41 with the cargo home whole; the explicit departure; the player seen to have arrived at Mercy.

objectives.text_ui: Use the barge's pilot lever and bring the grain to the landing
Take the skiff back to Mercy Crossing

not_imported: 'reads': mq01 done 100 / outcome is saved, as conditions of the writing's selector: the native gate is the Mercy travel point's.
The choice texts 'now' and 'later', which are writers' notes.
The evidence entry anchor_chain (a label seen from the skiff): Rafferty says it.
Everything the 'later' notes promise of the fair, of river service or of a price on the player: nothing of it is built or claimed.

flags.set_when: CompleteReturn only: the cargo SEEN at the landing by the road itself (its piece on, the lashed one off), whole (after a card win and the tow) or reduced (after the Chute). Never by 41 alone, and never by reaching the dock alone.

TellLie only: the share paid AND the lie explicitly told to Opal alive, present and in no fight (repair, finding 5). It is kept whatever she then answers and whatever becomes of her; her thanks in the journal (stage 46) and her cup wait for her answer. A paid share with Opal dead, gone or fighting before the lie, or with the lie never told, finishes the road without it.
Release only: the explicit 'Let him keep his boat.' with Hatcher alive, present, in no fight and free after a card win.
CompleteReturn of an escape only, with Hatcher alive, present and free at that moment. No speech, encounter or price is built.

LearnHire only, by the letter read or the admission heard. The writing's summary says 'has read Hatcher's letter'; the order and both reviews accept the admission (hatcher_paid sets 50 in the writing).
